commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
replication=0
if [ $replication -eq 1 ]; then
  # Production, DR and IAT
  acmon -a -t 5 5
  rc=$?
  if [ "_$rc" = "_0" ] ; then
    # check status of configured replicaiton clients
    acmon_repl_client.sh
  fi
else
  acmon -q -u -t 5 5
  rc=$?
fi

if [ "_$rc" != "_0" ] ; then
  exit $rc
fi
